label: Owner renewed the Agrippa/Münchhausen challenge to explanatory regress
summary:
Owner renewed the Agrippa/Münchhausen challenge to explanatory regress. Materialized/read the complete pinned Latta Monadology §§31–45, separating §32 universal explanatory scope and epistemic limitation, §§33–35 analytical termination, §§36–37 renewed contingent-detail demand and §45 proposed intrinsic existence reason. Existing unique-feedback, history-contrastive and regress fixed-point certificates already cover the formal omission tests; no duplicate theorem or opaque adequacy predicate is added. Leibniz argues against leaving the whole contingent sequence explained only by further contingent details, not against infinity as a cardinal or against every beginningless history. The independently disputed premises are whole-series PSR, the inadequacy of an undischarged contingent explanation-base, and the exclusion of intrinsic global/non-well-founded accounts. A brute global fact, a proposed global-structural account and a non-well-founded ground account are separate proposed rivals; no completed adequate ontic explanation is certified by the feedback control. Neither necessity nor a reason-token alone certifies the proposed necessary ground’s sufficiency. See the explanatory-adequacy audit in docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md for exact argument steps, theorem locators, rejected readings and remaining bridges. Intended/actual root-premise delta zero; no premise established, no source-free per se causal impossibility inferred. Follow-up positive-rival reading: read the complete official CC BY Welchance 2026 PDF (pp.1–21), with WELCHANCE-INFINITISM-1-3 now materializing pp.1–18. Common explanatory theory across existence facts is a positive defeasible virtue; parity permits local explanatory use of an unexplained chain just as an unexplained foundation. The source expressly does not establish actual infinitism or a completed totality explanation. The existing note now audits fact versus being relata, plural full versus binary partial grounds, ordinary examples, exclusions, structural-property justification, and abstraction to direct existential support. Rejected: parity as total-PSR satisfaction, generic grounding as conservation R, or formal acyclicity as adequacy. Bohn publisher metadata corrects the title to Indefinitely Descending Ground; BOHIDG and BOHIDGv1 fetches returned 403 and the author-linked NVA record was inaccessible. No chapter attribution is made. Remaining bridge: an independently defended intrinsic sufficient existence reason versus uniformity/parity under the same explanatory scope. Root delta remains zero; no new theorem/claim or philosophical vocabulary. Owner follow-up: reused #669 Klein–Turri finite-performance/available-reasons distinction without new sourcing. Finite inquiry may answer local challenges only under a defended truth-conducive adequacy norm; ontic grounds need not be traversed by thinkers. Added the exact order/rule burden: distinguish full joint ground from a partial arrow and defend obtaining, direction and rule application rather than enumeration, mutual entailment or recursive description. Welchance §1.3 n.15 leaves the further explanatory-link strategy undeveloped. Any rule being question-able does not alone refute it; independent warrant versus merely borrowed support is the issue. Recorded strongest conditional Occam argument: prefer an equally adequate account with fewer gratuitous independent commitments, comparing entity cardinality, kinds/laws, unexplained assumptions and specification length separately. Neither infinite members as infinite independent costs nor finite compression as adequate explanation is assumed. No new independent philosophical premise is defended; root delta zero. Extraction repair: full-PDF bytes unchanged; a bounded Poppler26.01.0 versus Ubuntu:noble24.02.0 comparison isolated CI text-hash drift to zero-width characters in the p.19 CC-license URL only. Materialized selection narrowed to pp.1–18, with identical cross-version text, retaining full-PDF raw hash and complete consulted context. No integrity gate or dependency change. Follow-up independently materialized/read Spinoza Elwes I definitions1–8, axioms1–7, propositions1–11 with I8 notes and all I11 proofs/note, and reread Aquinas q3a4/q44a1 and Monadology31–45. Positive intrinsic-nature reply and symmetric individual-adequacy constraint persist in docs/psr-scope-countermodels.md, Intrinsic existence reasons: I8 noteII and I11 triangle contrasts require explanation of individual existence/multiplicity rather than generic essential properties. Distinguished actual-witness presupposition from a fresh existence proof, and causa sui from efficient self-production. I7 needs explanatory exhaustiveness; I11 additionally owes internal consistency or a reality-to-existence-power bridge. Mathematical essential explanation motivates nonproductive reasons without establishing concrete instantiation. Foundation and global infinitist rivals both owe an independently characterized real nature/structure that explains actuality; neither bare necessity nor local dependency assignments discharge that debt. No new attribution record or formal adequacy flag; root delta zero.

2026-11-11 proposed foundation reassessment, evidence baseline 6d9b380099158c877373eaf34e2c6a9e4e6d01e4; independent semantic challenge pending. Reused #311/#613/#545/#487 exact local-transmission, unique-feedback, all-contributor Supply, actual infinite-chain, whole-roster/root, borrowing-cut/WF and newer #1378 whole-network controls. Selected warrant question: collective non-generation of existential actuality, not additional rank formalism. Re-materialized/read ALL existing pinned Pegis SCG I.13 [1]–[35], separating physical-infinity, first/intermediate, instrument/principal and second-way arguments. Source §7 allows dependence conditionals even with impossible antecedents; the disputed issue is universal scope, not performability of removing a first mover. The source §19 analysis gives a sharp application test: receiving an actuality presently lacking differs from continued dependence for an actuality presently possessed. Treating every existential receiver as presently nonactual would exclude finite founded instruments too. No new historical claim is registered. Positive local bearer-presupposition remains motivated under its interfaces; its extension to a whole plurality needs an actual whole bearer/act bridge, and strict priority alone permits endless priority. Rejected: no intrinsic actuality=no actual received actuality; conditional actuality=unfulfilled conditions; every received contribution=zero quantity; collecting acts=one self-producing act; unique state=actual realization; normalized/all-on assignment=metaphysical possibility. Strongest surviving positive rival supplies actual directed full constitutive or productive support at every level, including arrangement conditions; it still owes an independently characterized realization and global status. A genuinely independent concrete whole supporter could instead satisfy the weaker foundation target; a merely global fact is not a concrete bearer. Exact need is at least ONE actual root, not WF of all branches: source-anchored infinite controls only challenge the stronger standard. Existing necessaryActualRoot and underivedOfNecessaryRoot preserve the weaker route under explicit dependence and support interfaces. Proposed judgment: collective non-generation and actual realization remain underdetermined; no adequate infinite realization or independent foundation is established. Supply/cut/WF/whole-roster formulations must not be double-counted as warrant. Revision conditions, strengthened positive argument, strongest rival/price and several-level application audit persist in docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, Actual existential foundation. Next discriminating research: independently justify direction and full sufficiency of a specified constitutive existence account and its joint arrangements, then compare with the routing argument in the SAME existential meaning. No new statement/theorem/model/source record, closure/floor marking or premise discharge. Root premise change none; proposed synthesis must receive fresh semantic challenge before publication.
blocker: Independent collective non-generation and actual existential realization remain unestablished on the selected relation; local bearer-presupposition, actual population and conditional structural controls do not decide them. A source-free full constitutive/productive replacement needs relevant actual relata, arrangement conditions, direction and global actuality account. Another equivalent foundation formula would not discriminate. The weaker one-root route retains contingent dependence and explicit support interfaces; all-branch WF and modal union foundation are stronger separate obligations. Proposed 2026-11-11 judgment awaits independent semantic challenge.
